$$
\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} | \boldsymbol {V} | n \ell m \rangle = \alpha \langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} | \boldsymbol {W} | n \ell m \rangle . \tag {7.82}
$$

注释用 $j$ 代替 $\ell$ 无论状态是轨道、自旋或者总角动量的本征态，定理都成立)， $V = L + 2 S$ 和 $W = J$ 这证明了方程 (7.77).

证明由

$$
\left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {x} \left| n \ell m \right\rangle = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {-} \left| n \ell m \right\rangle + \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {+} \left| n \ell m \right\rangle \right],
$$

$$
\left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {y} \left| n \ell m \right\rangle = \frac {\mathrm {i}}{2} \left[ \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {-} \left| n \ell m \right\rangle - \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {+} \left| n \ell m \right\rangle \right],
$$

得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \boldsymbol {V} | n \ell m \rangle = \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {x} | n \ell m \rangle + \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {y} | n \ell m \rangle + \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {z} | n \ell m \rangle \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {-} \left| n \ell m \right\rangle + \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {+} \left| n \ell m \right\rangle \right] \\ + \frac {\mathrm {i}}{2} \left[ \langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} | \hat {V} _ {-} | n \ell m \rangle - \langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} | \hat {V} _ {+} | n \ell m \rangle \right] + \langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} | \hat {V} _ {z} | n \ell m \rangle . \\ \end{array}
$$

将方程 (6.59)"'(6.61)

$$
\left\langle n ^ {\prime} \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {+} | n \ell m \rangle = - \sqrt {2} C _ {m 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} \| V \| n \ell \right\rangle ,
$$

$$
\left\langle n ^ {\prime} \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {-} \left| n \ell m \right\rangle = \sqrt {2} C _ {m - 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell_ {1} \ell^ {\prime}} \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} \left\| V \right\| n \ell \right\rangle ,
$$

$$
\left\langle n ^ {\prime} \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \hat {V} _ {z} \left| n \ell m \right\rangle = C _ {m 0 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell_ {1} \ell^ {\prime}} \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} \left\| V \right\| n \ell \right\rangle ,
$$

代入，可得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \right| \boldsymbol {V} \left| n \ell m \right\rangle = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \sqrt {2} C _ {m - 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} \| V \| n \ell \right\rangle - \sqrt {2} C _ {m 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} \| V \| n \ell \right\rangle \right] \\ + \frac {\mathrm {i}}{2} \left[ \sqrt {2} C _ {m - 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} \| V \| n \ell \right\rangle + \sqrt {2} C _ {m 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 l ^ {\prime}} \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} \| V \| n \ell \right\rangle \right] \\ + C _ {m o m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} \| V \| n \ell \right\rangle \\ = \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} C _ {m - 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} C _ {m 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} + \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\sqrt {2}} C _ {m - 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} + \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\sqrt {2}} C _ {m 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} + C _ {m 0 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}}\right) \\ \cdot \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} \| V \| n \ell \right\rangle . \\ \end{array}
$$

同理，可得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle n \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} | W | n \ell m \rangle \\ = \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} C _ {m - 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} C _ {m 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} + \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\sqrt {2}} C _ {m - 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} + \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\sqrt {2}} C _ {m 1 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}} + C _ {m 0 m ^ {\prime}} ^ {\ell 1 \ell^ {\prime}}\right) \left\langle n \ell^ {\prime} \left\| W \right\| n \ell \right\rangle . \\ \end{array}
$$

前面的系数是一样的，困此两个矢量算符的矩阵元在角动量本征态的基矢下是成比例的.
